title: Very Berry Sorbet
description: A rich, fruity sorbet made from frozen mixed berries, sugar and egg whites. The egg whites prevent it becoming too icy and help it last longer.
steps: Heat the berries in a saucepan with 30g of the sugar for around 20 minutes over a low heat until soft. Mash roughly. Freeze for an hour.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, add the remaining sugar and whisk again.
When the frozen berries have ice crystals starting to form, remove from freezer and stir in the egg mixture.
Return to freezer for at least 4 hours, stirring twice in the first hour.
Scoop and serve, scattered with fresh mint if you like.
notes: Serves 6–8. The rich purple tones are lovely in a ripple effect.
